news.h: Why the Gokul Dairy election is sparking political outrage | The Hindu Editorial
news.catch: The Gokul Dairy controversy has become a flashpoint in Maharashtra politics after an ordinance allowed the state government to nominate voting directors to the cooperative’s board following a closely contested election. Critics argue that the move altered the balance of power after a Congress-backed panel won a majority of elected seats…

news.h: Indonesia's Vice President resigns as eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
news.catch: The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents submitted by Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the 39-year-old son of former President Joko Widodo, regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements

quiz.q: Who is the Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation?
quiz.e: V. Narayanan is Chairman of ISRO and Secretary, Department of Space.

quiz.q: GSLV-F18, launched on 30 October 2026, carried which satellite?
quiz.e: GSLV-F18 carried NVS-03, a second-generation navigation satellite, restoring the NavIC constellation to four satellites.

quiz.q: ISRO's first uncrewed mission under the Gaganyaan programme is intended to:
o: land a rover near the lunar south pole
test the crew module and escape systems before a crewed flight
place a space station module in orbit
study the sun from the L1 point
quiz.e: The G1 uncrewed mission tests the crew module, its parachutes and escape systems before Indian astronauts fly.

quiz.q: The target year set by India for commissioning the Bharatiya Antariksh Station is:
quiz.e: The Bharatiya Antariksh Station is targeted for 2035, with the first module planned by 2028, ahead of a crewed Moon landing by 2040.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for:
o: the discovery of light-gated ion channels and optogenetics
the discovery of the hepatitis C virus
quiz.e: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honoured for optogenetics, which allows individual nerve cells to be switched on or off with light.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen for:
o: the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and high-energy astrophysical neutrinos
the invention of the blue LED
quiz.e: Halzen was honoured for turning a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice into the IceCube detector and for the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognised work on:
o: non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric synthesis
quiz.e: Henri Kagan of France and Kenso Soai of Japan were honoured for explaining how living systems came to contain one of two mirror-image forms of a molecule.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to:
quiz.e: The Canadian poet and translator Anne Carson was honoured for an oeuvre in dialogue with the classical tradition.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navi Pillay for:
o: efforts to promote peace and international law
quiz.e: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay, the South African jurist, was honoured for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

quiz.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded for work that produced:
o: New Keynesian models of macroeconomic stabilisation
quiz.e: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford were honoured for the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation, used by central banks worldwide.
